build_model_transformer_wrapper: build a GPT-like decoder model using TransformerWrapper with configurable dimensions and rotary position embeddings
create_entropy_based_tokenizer: create an EntropyBasedTokenizer that segments sequences by entropy threshold on a decoder model
wrap_model_autoregressive: wrap a TransformerWrapper model with AutoregressiveWrapper for autoregressive generation and loss computation
train_model_gradient_accumulation: train the autoregressive model with gradient accumulation, gradient clipping, and periodic validation
decode_tokens_to_string: decode token IDs to human-readable strings by mapping integer values to ASCII characters
